theory.title: Asking for Clarification
theory.intro: This lesson teaches the learner how to ask for more precision and meaning during interaction. It is an important next step after simply asking for help.
content: Use Can you clarify this? when something is still unclear.

theory.title: Reviewing Help Requests and Clarification
theory.intro: This lesson reviews the first half of Phase 3 by combining requests for help, statements of difficulty and clarification language.
content: Use Can you help me...? to ask for support.
Use I need help with... and I don't understand... to explain the problem clearly.
Use Can you clarify this? and What does this mean? to request more precision.
These forms work together in real communication: first ask, then explain, then clarify.
The focus of this checkpoint is integration, not new complexity.

theory_pt.title: Revisando Pedidos de Ajuda e Esclarecimento
theory_pt.intro: Esta lição revisa a primeira metade da Fase 3 combinando pedidos de ajuda, declarações de dificuldade e linguagem de esclarecimento.
content: Use Can you help me...? para pedir apoio.
Use I need help with... e I don't understand... para explicar o problema com clareza.
Use Can you clarify this? e What does this mean? para pedir mais precisão.
Essas formas funcionam juntas na comunicação real: primeiro peça, depois explique, depois esclareça.
O foco deste checkpoint é integração, não nova complexidade.

theory.title: Reviewing Confirmation and Coordination
theory.intro: This lesson reviews how learners confirm understanding and organize simple shared actions. It is the bridge between support and execution.
content: Use So, is this correct? and Okay, I understand now. to close the clarification cycle.
Use Let's... to suggest shared action.
Use First... and Then... to organize simple sequences.
Use I can... and you can... to divide tasks clearly.
The goal is alignment: both people understand and know what to do next.
examples: Let's do this step by step.
First, read this. Then, send the answer.
I can send the file and you can check it.

theory_pt.title: Revisando Confirmação e Coordenação
theory_pt.intro: Esta lição revisa como os alunos confirmam compreensão e organizam ações simples compartilhadas. É a ponte entre apoio e execução.
content: Use So, is this correct? e Okay, I understand now. para fechar o ciclo de esclarecimento.
Use Let's... para sugerir ação compartilhada.
Use First... e Then... para organizar sequências simples.
Use I can... e you can... para dividir tarefas com clareza.
O objetivo é alinhamento: as duas pessoas entendem e sabem o que fazer a seguir.

theory.title: Reviewing Progress and Status Updates
theory.intro: This lesson reviews how the learner can make a short and useful task update by combining current action, completed work and pending work.
content: Use I am working on... to describe work in progress.
Use I finished... and I already... to describe completed work.
Use I still need to... to describe pending work.
Use I am almost done. to show near completion.
This kind of update is common in teamwork, study groups, project flows and support interactions.
examples: I am working on this now.
I still need to check the link.

Incorrect: I still need check the link. → Correct: I still need to check the link.

theory_pt.title: Revisando Progresso e Updates de Status
theory_pt.intro: Esta lição revisa como o aluno pode fazer um update curto e útil de tarefa combinando ação atual, trabalho concluído e trabalho pendente.
content: Use I am working on... para descrever trabalho em andamento.

Use I still need to... para descrever trabalho pendente.

theory.title: Completing the Collaboration Checkpoint
theory.intro: The final lesson of Week 12 integrates the full communication cycle of Phase 3: request, difficulty, clarification, confirmation, coordination and progress update.
content: A full collaborative interaction often includes: asking for help, naming the problem, asking for clarification, confirming understanding, coordinating action and reporting progress.
This lesson does not add major new structures. It integrates what the learner already knows.
The learner should now be able to sustain a short but meaningful exchange in a study or task-based context.
The checkpoint is important because it validates practical communication, not isolated sentence knowledge.

O aluno agora deve ser capaz de sustentar uma troca curta, mas significativa, em contexto de estudo ou tarefa.
O checkpoint é importante porque valida comunicação prática, não conhecimento de frases isoladas.
Esta performance final marca prontidão para ir além da terceira insígnia.
